extDesc.message: Local outfit try-on: swaps your face onto models in product photos. All processing happens in your browser.

noPhotoHint.message: Upload a front-facing photo of yourself — it's used to build the try-on. The photo stays on this device and is never sent anywhere.

foreheadMaskHint.message: Raises the swap edge into the hairline — the seam is less visible.

matchGenderHint.message: Turn off to try on looks for any gender.

errNoFace.message: No face found in the photo. Use a clear front-facing portrait.

errMultiFace.message: Multiple faces found in the photo ($COUNT$). Upload a photo with only your own face.

errFaceTooSmall.message: The face in the photo is too small. Use a closer portrait.

statusPipelineError.message: Couldn't process this page. Try reloading it.

statusNoPhoto.message: Upload your photo — the swap won't work without it.

statusNoneFound.message: No faces to replace found yet

onboardingStepSite.message: Open one of the marketplaces (links below)
